issue_context.title: Bug: Right-click menu on homepage
issue_context.body:
### Description

When you maximized the Files window and then right-click the item on the right side of the page of the homepage, you will get a menu leaked outside the screen - I can't see it.
Just like this:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ca1d795e-8653-466e-a76e-5cdddf5bf83d)
This doesn't happen on any other pages.
Please fix it - although I don't think it's really necessary.
Thanks!

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Click on the navigation bar on the left to open Homepage.
2. Maximize the Files window.
3. Right-click an item on the right side like this:![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8d235914-c7f3-41e8-872c-9894d70b9f93)
4. You will find the problem.

### Requirements

- e.g. Fix right-click menu leak when clicking on a right side item on the homepage.


### Files Version

3.7.11.0

### Windows Version

10.0.26100.2033

### User ID

a2a077a5-f4d9-4311-98d4-155b85123aa6

### Log File

[debug.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17556912/debug.log)
I think there's nothing on the log file.
